description: mta_sts_fetcher.rs enforces three security invariants correctly: no redirects (Policy::none()), WebPKI-only cert validation (system roots, no custom CA), and a body size cap. Each invariant has an RFC citation in the doc comment. The SSRF note is honest about what is and is not mitigated. A contributor might suggest 'simplify by using the default client' — the no-redirect policy is the reason this cannot be done, and the doc comment makes that clear.
title: Security invariants for fetch_url are well-engineered and documented
